content.value_statement: Financial analysis needs clear assumptions, repeatable calculations, and risk visibility. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structure valuation models and scenario analysis.
actual_capabilities: Build discounted cash flow models with revenue, margin, tax, capital expenditure, and working capital assumptions.
Calculate WACC, terminal value, enterprise value, equity value, and implied valuation multiples.
Create one-way and two-way sensitivity tables for key value drivers.
Run Monte Carlo simulations with probability distributions and valuation confidence intervals.
Compare best, base, and worst case scenarios with probability-weighted outcomes.
Generate charts and summaries for valuation ranges, tornado analysis, and risk metrics.
limitations: The skill does not replace professional financial, tax, legal, or investment advice.
Model quality depends on the accuracy of user-provided financial data and assumptions.
Market, regulatory, and company conditions can change after a model is built.
It provides analysis support, not a guarantee of investment performance.

use_cases.title: Value a Company
use_cases.description: Create a DCF valuation from historical financials and explicit operating assumptions.

use_cases.title: Test Deal Assumptions
use_cases.description: Compare valuation outcomes across growth, margin, WACC, and exit multiple assumptions.

use_cases.title: Assess Project Risk
use_cases.description: Run scenario and Monte Carlo analysis for capital projects with uncertain inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic DCF
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner valuation model from supplied company data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build a five-year DCF model for the attached company financials. Show assumptions, free cash flow, terminal value, and equity value.

prompt_templates.title: Run Sensitivity Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of key valuation drivers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to test how revenue growth and WACC affect valuation. Create a two-way sensitivity table and summarize the most important drivers.

prompt_templates.title: Model Scenario Outcomes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across multiple operating cases.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build best, base, and worst case scenarios for this investment. Include probability weights and compare expected values.

prompt_templates.title: Stress Test Uncertainty
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced risk analysis with probabilistic inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to run a Monte Carlo valuation with 5,000 iterations. Define distributions for growth, margins, WACC, and terminal value assumptions.

output_examples.input: Build a DCF model for a software company using five years of historical financials.
output_examples.output: A valuation summary with projected revenue, free cash flow, WACC, terminal value, enterprise value, equity value, and implied multiples.

output_examples.input: Show how valuation changes when WACC and terminal growth move across realistic ranges.
output_examples.output: A sensitivity table, a short driver summary, and a clear explanation of which assumptions have the largest valuation impact.

output_examples.input: Estimate the risk of a project missing its required return under uncertain demand and margin assumptions.
output_examples.output: A Monte Carlo summary with median outcome, confidence interval, downside probability, and key inputs that drive risk.

best_practices: Provide source financial statements, units, time periods, and currency before building a model.
Document every major assumption and separate inputs from calculations and outputs.
Review sensitivity and scenario results before using a model for decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not use default assumptions when company-specific data is available.
Do not treat model outputs as predictions without explaining uncertainty and risks.
Do not mix audited data, estimates, and management targets without labels.

faq.question: What types of financial models can this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports DCF valuation, sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, scenario planning, project finance, M&A analysis, and LBO analysis.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide historical financials, forecast assumptions, discount rate inputs, terminal value assumptions, and the decision you need to support.

faq.question: Can this skill create investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure analysis and explain model outputs, but it is not a substitute for licensed professional advice.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, and includes Python scripts for modeling workflows.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee accurate valuations?
faq.answer: No. Valuations depend on the quality of data, assumptions, market context, and professional judgment.

faq.question: How should I review outputs before sharing them?
faq.answer: Check assumptions, formulas, scenario ranges, and source data. Also confirm that conclusions match the model limits.
